values.note: Fully paved with paved spurs. recreation.gov lists 43 sites (two group sites, #1 and #44); most single sites take 24-56 ft, and pull-through site 036 is listed at 90 ft, matching the Forest Service's 'Max Trailer Length: 90ft'.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/woodbine-campground ('Camp sites: 44', 'Fully paved campground with paved spurs', 'Max Trailer Length : 90ft') + recreation.gov per-site catalog (catx.py: Max Vehicle Length 24-90, 2 Pull-Through), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Accessible vault toilets and drinking water; bear-resistant dumpster and some bear-resistant food lockers. Camp host on site sells firewood.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/woodbine-campground ('accessible vault toilets and drinking water', 'Host : Yes', 'Trash Pickup: Bear resistant dumpster', 'Some sites equipped with bear resistant food storage lockers') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233238 ('Firewood bundles can be purchased from the campground host'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 8 sites are first-come, first-served (booked in person on site only; don't call); the rest are by reservation only on recreation.gov, up to 6 months ahead. The Forest Service says reservations close 24 hours before the stay; recreation.gov's rule is a 2-day cutoff. Outside the reserved season (in 2026, May 1-21 and September 11-30) recreation.gov's rate table lists first-come, first-served seasons. Late arrivals are held 24 hours. Concessionaire-run (recreation.gov contact camping@rrmofa.com).

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/woodbine-campground ('Reservations can be made up to 24 hours in advance of stay. Reservations can be made up to 6 months in advance', '8 sites at woodbine are first come/first serve sites. The remainder of the sites at this campground are by reservations only', '16 day maximum stay') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233238 (rules: maxConsecutiveStay 16, reservationCutOff 2; notices 'FIRST COME FIRST SERVE sites must be booked in person', 'Late Arrivals ... not considered a no-show until 24 hours') + /rates, read 2026-10-22

note: Custer Gallatin NF (Beartooth RD), on the banks of the Stillwater River at 5,300 ft at the end of Stillwater River Road #2400, adjacent to the Absaroka-Beartooth Wilderness; 7 mi south of Nye, 57 mi west of Red Lodge. Wooded and shady. The 1.5-mile round-trip Woodbine Falls Trail starts in the campground; the Stillwater Trail (#24) reaches Sioux Charley Lake in 3 miles. Very popular on summer weekends and holidays. --Claude
summary: Concessionaire-run (recreation.gov contact rrmofa.com) for the Forest Service (Beartooth RD); reservable on recreation.gov with 8 FCFS sites. Confirmed $20 (2026), no electric, 44 sites, vault toilets, reservable on recreation.gov; added 90-ft max (FS + catalog), pull-throughs, potable water, 6-month window (confirms inherited 180), fcfs some_sites, 16-day limit. Season left as derived (FS gives only 'Fees Charged May – September'). Note: dropped the '~32 ft max recommended trailer' line the pages contradict, and restated values.
